items.method: electron probe microanalyser (EPMA) equipped with a wavelength dispersive Xeray analyser (WDX)
items.quote: Microstructural observation of diffusion couple and alloy was carried out using a JXAe8100R electron probe microanalyser (EPMA) equipped with a wavelength dispersive Xeray analyser (WDX).
The magnetic properties of the films were measured by using a VSMe5e15 vibrating sample magnetometer at room temperature.
The film thickness was measured by using a DektakeIII surface profiler.
The microstructural observation for the thin film was carried out using a F30eHRTEM transmission electron microscope (TEM) operated at 300 kV.
